Bear Form.description: While raging or in a frenzy, a bear warrior can shift into bear shape, functioning similarly to polymorph. The number of daily transformations is limited by how many times per day he can rage or enter a frenzy, and he reverts to his normal shape when the rage or frenzy concludes. He keeps the standard +2 bonus to Will saves and -2 penalty to Armor Class from raging, but the usual ability score bonuses from rage or frenzy are replaced by Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution bonuses determined by the chosen bear shape. As with polymorph, the bear warrior acquires the physical characteristics of the bear form (size, speed, natural armor bonus, natural weapons, space, and reach) along with any extraordinary special attacks that form possesses (for example, improved grab when in brown bear or dire bear shape). The transformation persists for as long as the rage or frenzy lasts. Unlike polymorph, the bear warrior does not adopt the bear's actual Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution scores, nor does he recover hit points upon transforming. His current hit points do increase from the new Constitution bonus, following the standard rules for rage. Starting at 1st level, a bear warrior can take black bear form once per day, gaining a +8 bonus to Strength, +2 bonus to Dexterity, and +4 bonus to Constitution. Upon reaching 5th level, he can transform twice daily and may select either black or brown bear shape. In brown bear form, he receives a +16 bonus to Strength, +2 bonus to Dexterity, and +8 bonus to Constitution. At 10th level, he can transform three times per day and may choose from black, brown, or dire bear forms. Dire bear form grants a +20 bonus to Strength, +2 bonus to Dexterity, and +8 bonus to Constitution.

Rage.description: At 7th level, a bear warrior gains one additional use per day of his rage or frenzy ability. For instance, a character with 7 levels of barbarian and 7 levels of bear warrior would have three daily uses of rage. If that character then gained another barbarian level, the total would increase to four uses per day.

Scent.description: Beginning at 3rd level, a bear warrior permanently gains the scent special ability, which functions in both his natural form and any bear shape he assumes.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: This prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.

overrides.description: Bear warriors forge a spiritual bond with bear totems, channeling ursine ferocity in combat. When they enter a battle fury, they physically transform into bears, gaining the raw power and resilience of these mighty creatures.
